title: Operations Platform for Agencies
short_description: A 0→1 operations platform for account hierarchies, contacts, communication, and team access.
long_description: This independent prototype models agency clients at both company and location level while keeping contacts, communication, team access, and activity history connected.

title: Redis Integration
short_description: A production caching layer that turns expensive page builds into fast, observable responses.
long_description: I designed and integrated a Redis caching system for a large network of multi-location marketing sites. It dramatically reduced repeat page-build times while adding clear cache-hit logging, performance metrics, and operational visibility for the engineering team.
image_alt: Redis database performance and latency metrics

title: UVU Feud
short_description: A Jackbox-style multiplayer game with distinct player, host, and gameboard experiences.
long_description: UVU Feud turns the familiar Family Feud format into a synchronized, multi-screen web game. Socket.io keeps every participant in sync while the Node.js service manages rounds, responses, scoring, and game state.
